buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Scope of Supply · Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of the Ultrasonic harmonic scalpel () Machine at the consignee location, including all standard accessories, probes/transducers, cables, software, manuals and items necessary for complete functioning. · Bid price shall include all applicable costs required for delivery and commissioning, as specified in the GeM bid . · The offered equipment shall comply with the technical specifications published in the GeM bid/catalogue and a ll applicable statutory requirements. 2. Technical Compliance · The bidder shall quote only equipment meeting or exceeding every mandatory technical parameter specified i n the GeM bid. · A clause-by-clause compliance statement shall be submitted against the published technical specifications, wh erever enabled/required in the GeM bid. · Equivalent or superior specifications may be considered only where permitted by the GeM category and subjec t to technical evaluation. · No deviation from mandatory specifications shall be accepted unless expressly permitted in the bid. 3. Regulatory & Statutory Compliance · The offered equipment shall comply with applicable Government of India laws, rules and regulatory requireme nts, including requirements applicable to medical devices and diagnostic Ultrasonic harmonic scalpel equipment. · The bidder/OEM shall provide valid licences, registrations, certificates and other statutory documents required for lawful supply, installation and operation.

· The equipment shall meet requirements under the PCPNDT Act/Rules and other applicable regulatory provisio ns governing Ultrasonic harmonic scalpel facilities and equipment. 4. OEM / Manufacturer Authorization · The bidder shall be the OEM or an authorized channel partner/reseller and such authorization is required to be submitted in the GeM bid. · Manufacturer authorization/dealership documents will be submitted by the bidder. · OEM details, product literature and model information shall be clearly identifiable in the bid documents. 5. Delivery, Installation & Commissioning · Delivery of equipment shall be completed within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract/ order. · Installation, testing and commissioning shall be carried out by trained/ authorized service engineer at the cons ignee site within 10 days from delivery of equipment. · The supplier shall demonstrate basic operation and provide training to user/ operator at the consignee site at t he time of installation, within 10 days from delivery of equipment. Installation shall include configuration of all supplied accessories and probes and verification of satisfactory ope ration. 6. Warranty · The warranty of the eqpt should be 05 years. Comprehensive preventive maintenance support to be provided during warranty period. 7. Preventive Maintenance & Breakdown Service · The supplier shall provide preventive maintenance and breakdown services during the shelf life of equipment. · The breakdown response shall be within 24 hrs and resolution shall be within 3-4 days. · If equipment downtime exceeds the permitted period of seven (07) days, the remedies such as extension of w arranty/ service period will be applied. 8. Consumables, Accessories & Documentation · All standard accessories supplied with the quoted/ supplied model shall be provided compatible with equipme nt. · User manual, service/ maintenance documentation, installation report, warranty certificate and relevant certifi cates shall be handed over to the consignee. · The software required for normal operation of equipment shall be supplied with valid licence/ activation key. 9. Acceptance & Inspection · The consignee/user department shall inspect the equipment after delivery and installation. · Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory verification of quantity, model, accessories, technical compliance, i nstallation and functional performance. · Payment/acceptance shall be governed by the applicable GeM terms, contract conditions and satisfactory rece ipt/acceptance by the consignee. 10. Training · Supplier/OEM shall provide on-site basic user training for 02 days to designated personnel, including operation , safety, cleaning and routine care of the eqpt. · Training shall be conducted by competent/authorized personnel and shall be completed withing 02 Days imme diately after commissioning.

11. Make in India / MSE / Purchase Preference · Applicable Government of India policies on Make in India, local content, MSE purchase preference and other pr ocurement preferences shall be followed as applicable and as configured in the GeM bid. · Eligibility and preference conditions shall be interpreted in accordance with the extant Government orders and GeM provisions. 12. Bid Validity & GeM Conditions · The bid validity, bid security/EMD provisions, performance security, payment terms, delivery terms, liquidated damages and other commercial conditions shall be governed by the GeM bid, GeM GTC/STC and applicable GeM pro visions. · Participation in the bid shall constitute acceptance of applicable GeM terms and conditions, subject to the prov isions stated in the bid. · The buyer shall use only the eligibility criteria and additional terms/conditions permitted through GeM's availa ble bid/ATC mechanisms. 13. Inspection / Rejection · Equipment may be rejected if it is materially different from the quoted/accepted specifications, incomplete, da maged, non-functional, or fails required acceptance tests. · Rejected equipment shall be replaced/corrected by the supplier at no additional cost rejected eqpt to be collec ted by supplier with in 01 week from consignee site. 14.Shelf Life of Equipment : The equipment should have minimum shelf life of 10 years. 15. Malicious Code : Malicious Code Certificate (as per GeM GTC): (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Emb edded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of inform ation or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 16. Requirement of additional documents 16.1 ISO 9001 Cert. 16.2 No Obsolete cert from vendor. 16.3 No Blacklist undertaking by vendor / Bidder Financial standing undertaking. 16.4 GST PAN/NEFT/Cheque. 16.5 Earliest Yr of Manufacture may be specified. 16.6 ATC Compliance / Bid Compliance. 16.7 IP and patent rights. 16.8 Shelf Life of item required minimum 10 years. 16.9 Clarification Regarding contents of the Bids. 16.10 Land border Cert as per GFR 144(xi). 16.11 Technical compliance statement / specification sheet. 16.12 OEM authorization from vendor. 16.13 Product brochure/datasheet identifying the offered model.
